observations.trace: Build.rs merges JSON-compatible YAML catalog documents, resolves repertoire fragments, calls name_catalog_validation::validate and serializes the resulting catalog into an embedded JSON constant. The validator requires every per-sex family entry and every surname entry to be positive, unique, and linked to eligible identities, but does not sum those groups. It separately uses checked_add for each family form group, and derivations must exactly match each individual eligible target and link to observations. For a hypothetical eligible sex group containing two distinct families weighted u64::MAX and1, with every other family, form, surname, selector and provenance requirement satisfied, those two positive weights exceed u64 only in aggregate. Rand0.9.5 WeightedIndex source uses checked_add_assign and returns Overflow; deterministic weighted_index maps that to SamplingError::WeightOverflow. Runtime generator maps it to NameCatalogError::Sampling(String), and the selected starting-character helper calls expect on generation. A surname group with those two positive totals has the corresponding gap when no inherited surname is supplied.
observations.remaining: No full synthetic catalog, authored content inventory, build, sampler, overflow, panic or product test ran. Conditional eligibility and real corpus weights remain unverified. Form-group overflow is already checked; do not claim all weights are unchecked. Exact feature resolution and other consumers remain open.

observations.trace: The deterministic SamplingError enum distinguishes EmptyCandidates, ZeroTotalWeight and WeightOverflow. All three naming generator sampling calls format that value into NameCatalogError::Sampling(String); NameCatalogError implements Error without a source override. Selected database CharacterNameError retains the outer NameCatalogError as InvalidName, while the selected starting helper calls expect. The original Adler q134 and delegated Lens12 q286 identify the same three maps and owner-level loss of the typed cause; their original records remain separate and do not establish global all20-family alias closure.
observations.remaining: No error occurred, no runtime or test ran, and full downstream consumer, native and cross-family comparison remain open. Separate validator String classifications are related but not automatically the same cause.

observations.contract: Catalog validation classification and semantic ID transport
observations.trace: The shared validator returns String from recursive checks, while build.rs formats failures at the build-script leaf. Runtime catalog() retains NameCatalogDocument with raw source-definition ID Strings. NameFamilyId, NameFormId and SurnameId are distinct semantic owners but expose public String and are unwrapped to &str when passed into the private render helpers. PersonalNameIdentity::validate resolves family, form and surname membership and native form coherence before render. The selected database assignment renders and validates before writing the identity and display.
observations.remaining: The selected retention and propagation question is not proof that every ID needs the same constructor or that a product failure occurred. Authored and historical unresolved identities, including empty unresolved candidates, have separate intentional representations; exact owner and native consumers remain open.

observations.contract: Validated catalog spelling versus rendered-name admission
observations.trace: Catalog form validators reject a given or surname form only when its text trims to empty, while RenderedPersonalName rejects control characters, leading or trailing whitespace, empty text and text longer than160 characters. If an otherwise eligible catalog form contains a nonempty spelling such as Given followed by a newline and Name, form validation does not reject the control character. When that form is selected, identity reference validation does not validate its text and render_personal_name eventually passes the projected text to RenderedPersonalName::new, which rejects it. Selected database assignment validates rendering before storage.
observations.remaining: Source-only hypothetical; no catalog data inspected for this value and no fixture, build, generation or rendering ran. Whether all accepted catalog spellings must be directly displayable is a contract decision; scope of authored data and all render contexts remain open.

observations.contract: Inherited surname before generated identity return
observations.trace: SurnameId is a public String newtype with an unchecked new constructor. Assuming repertoire lookup and family/form sampling succeed, generate_personal_name_from_catalog accepts Some(SurnameId::new(" ")) and returns it without calling identity.validate. A build-validated catalog cannot contain that whitespace ID because validate_id permits only lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscores. A later identity.validate or render resolves surname membership and would return MissingCatalogEntry; selected database assignment renders before storing.
observations.remaining: No identity, sample, catalog lookup, validation, product or test ran. The public generator may intentionally require a caller-provided valid inherited identity; decide its contract and inspect remaining callers before treating this as a supported-boundary defect.
